title: Neural quantum support vector data description for one-class classification
summary: One-class classification (OCC) is a fundamental problem in machine learning with numerous applications, such as anomaly detection and quality control. With the increasing complexity and dimensionality of modern datasets, there is a growing demand for advanced OCC techniques with better expressivity and efficiency. We introduce Neural Quantum Support Vector Data Description (NQSVDD), a classical-quantum hybrid framework for OCC that performs end-to-end optimized hierarchical representation learning.
